title: Selected Study Modules
components:
Discussion
Independent Study
Lecture
Others
Project
description: Students undertake a Selected Study Module (SSM), working on it throughout the academic year. The aim of SSM is to provide students with an opportunity to participate in a research project, critique scientific literature, conduct a topical analysis or systematic review, and acquire some of the skill sets needed for undertaking scientific research. Allowing free choice of project facilitates students to critically explore topics that they find interesting.The following students are exempted from the course:1. Students who have successfully completed the Master of Science Programme in Research Medicine;2. GPS students who have successfully completed the interim report of the GPSU3100 GPS Project; or3. Students who have achieved an overall result of "Satisfactory (3)" or higher in the pilot Artificial Intelligence Research Internship (AIRI) or the course MEDU3010 Artificial Intelligence Research Internship.
outcome: After the SSM, the students should be able to:  1. realize the importance of lifelong, self-directed learning, and  2. appreciate the necessity of having skills to acquire new knowledge in order to meet the challenge of society's ever changing demands.
syllabus: Free choice of project areas will enable students to explore critically and pursue subjects and topics that excite them.
required_readings: Required readings for this course will be determined by the supervisors, based on the specific topic or project area under their guidance.
recommended_readings: Recommended readings will be suggested by the supervising professor, tailored to the topic or project area under their guidance.
